text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Tamamo Cross is unsteady 
on her feet from malnutrition. When asked 
why she eats so little...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reason was 'childhood poverty.' From 
constantly giving up her food to her 
younger siblings, her stomach had shrunk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to prove she wouldn't be easily 
pushed around, she challenged the massive 
Hishi Akebono to a sumo match, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
[Twinkle Sumo: Make Debut Basho] ○ Hishi 
Akebono ● Tamamo Cross (Winning technique: 
Oshidashi)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that victory would remain out of 
reach like this, she decided to steadily 
compete in races while strengthening her 
body until next spring.
